[[File:Jean.png|thumb|250px|Jean]] '''Jean''' (Japanese: '''ジーン''' ''Jean'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY078|Lights! Camera! Pika!]]''. She is the granddaughter of [[Frank]]. Jean helps out her grandfather in his mansion, the [[Pikachu Manor]]. She also helps him with making his movies, operating the camera, applying makeup on the actors, and editing the scenes that were filmed. She was also in charge of projecting the movie she made with her grandfather and {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} called ''{{DL|Movies in the Pokémon world|Lightning Fast! Brave and Strong! Super-Pikachu!}}'' during the premiere showing. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{electric color light}}|bordercolor={{electric color dark}} |ja=下屋則子 ''[[Noriko Shitaya]]'' |en=[[Samara Naeymi]] |fi=Annituuli Kasurinen |es_eu=Amalia Cantarero |it=Giulia Maniglio }}
